app.name: Pharmacy Inventory
app.tagline: Multi-branch pharmacy inventory, POS and loyalty management

auth.signInHint: Sign in with the account your pharmacy owner invited you with.
auth.trust: Protected by two-factor authentication and row-level security.
auth.heroTitle: Run every branch from one place
auth.heroBody: Fast counter billing, expiry-first stock, loyalty cards and live reports — built for Bangladeshi pharmacies.
heroPoints: Nearest-expiry stock is sold first, automatically
Bangla and English, light and dark
Owner sees every branch in real time
auth.mfaVerifyBody: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
auth.mfaEnrollBody: Owners and managers must protect their account. Scan this QR code with Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator, then enter the 6-digit code.
auth.mfaSecret: Can't scan? Enter this key manually
auth.skipHint: Salespeople may skip. Owner and manager features stay locked until this is set up.
auth.codeInvalid: That code didn't work. Check the time on your phone and try again.

onboarding.title: Set up your pharmacy
onboarding.body: Create your pharmacy and its first branch. You can add more branches and staff later.
onboarding.branchCodeHint: 2–6 letters, printed on invoices (e.g. MPR → MPR-2627-000001).
onboarding.noAccessBody: If you are an owner or manager, finish two-factor setup to see your pharmacy. Otherwise ask the owner to invite you.

dashboard.subtitle: Here's how {{branch}} is doing today.
dashboard.salesTrendBody: Net sales after returns and voids
dashboard.expiringBody: Batches expiring in the next {{days}} days

pos.title: Point of sale
pos.search: Search medicine, generic or scan barcode
pos.emptyCartBody: Search for a medicine and press Enter to add it.
pos.estimateNote: Final price, loyalty discount and batch allocation are calculated securely by the server.
pos.prescriptionBody: This bill contains controlled or prescription-only medicines.

inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.subtitle: Stock, expiry and reorder alerts for {{branch}}
inventory.noStock: No stock in this branch yet
inventory.noStockBody: Load opening stock or receive a purchase from the Purchases page.

medicines.title: Medicines
medicines.subtitle: {{n}} medicines in your catalog
medicines.dialogBody: The catalog is shared by all branches. Rack and reorder level are saved for {{branch}}.
medicines.unitHint: Stock and prices are counted per this unit.

scheduleHint.otc: Can be sold without a prescription.
scheduleHint.controlled: Narcotic or psychotropic: the POS asks for prescription details.

medicines.reorderHint: Warn when stock falls to this
medicines.barcodesHint: Scan or type; separate several with commas.
medicines.emptyBody: Add the medicines you sell. Then load opening stock or receive a purchase in Purchases.

purchases.subtitle: Receive supplier invoices and load stock into {{branch}}
purchases.noAccessBody: Purchase prices are visible to owners, managers and accountants only.
purchases.addMedicine: Add medicine: type a name or scan a barcode
purchases.noItemsBody: Search above to add each medicine on the supplier's invoice.
purchases.openingBody: Count what is on the shelves today and enter it batch by batch. Do this once when the branch starts using the system.
purchases.openingNote: Cost is your purchase price per unit; it is used for profit reports and is never shown to salespeople.

customers.subtitle: {{n}} customers
customers.dialogBody: Customers are shared by all branches. A mobile number is needed for a loyalty card.
customers.name: Customer name
customers.phoneHint: Used to find the customer and for loyalty cards.
customers.emptyBody: Add regular customers to sell on credit and give them loyalty cards.

loyalty.subtitle: Membership cards with discounts and points, valid in every branch
loyalty.searchMembers: Search name, mobile or card no.
loyalty.enrollBody: Issue a loyalty card or renew a membership. A renewal starts the day after the current one ends.
loyalty.findCustomer: Find customer by name or mobile
loyalty.cardNoHint: Leave empty to generate one, or type a pre-printed card number.
loyalty.noActivePlan: No plan is offered yet. The owner sets fee and benefits in Loyalty → Plans.
loyalty.noMembersBody: Enroll a customer to issue the first loyalty card.
loyalty.cancelBody: {{name}} will lose the discount immediately. The fee is not refunded automatically.
loyalty.replaceBody: {{name}}'s old card stops working; membership and points move to the new card.
loyalty.programmeBody: When off, no card gives a discount or earns points, and no one can enroll.
loyalty.ownerOnly: Only the owner can change plans.

comingSoon.title: Coming in the next milestone
comingSoon.body: The database for this module is ready and tested. Its screens are being built next.

errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network: You appear to be offline. Check the internet connection.
errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to do that.
errors.mfa_required: Verify with two-factor authentication to continue.
errors.discount_limit: This discount is above your limit. Ask a manager.
errors.credit_limit: This would exceed the customer's credit limit.
errors.customer_required: Select a customer to sell on credit.
errors.prescription_required: Prescription details are required for this bill.
errors.loyalty_inactive: This loyalty card has no active membership today.
errors.overpayment: Card and mobile payments cannot exceed the total.
errors.invalid_phone: Enter a valid Bangladeshi mobile number (01XXXXXXXXX).
errors.duplicate_medicine: This medicine (same brand, form, strength and company) already exists.
errors.duplicate_sku: Another medicine already uses this SKU.
errors.duplicate_barcode: This barcode already belongs to another medicine.
errors.invalid_barcode: Barcodes are 4–64 letters, digits or dashes.
errors.invalid_medicine_field: One of the fields is too long or invalid.
errors.duplicate_supplier: A supplier with this name already exists.
errors.not_found: Not found. It may have been removed.
errors.expired_batch: Expiry date must be in the future.
errors.price_above_mrp: Sale price cannot be above MRP.
errors.invalid_price: MRP must be greater than zero.
errors.invalid_quantity: Quantity must be a whole number greater than zero.
errors.duplicate_items: The same medicine batch appears twice.
errors.invalid_discount: Discount must be between zero and the subtotal.
errors.invalid_payment: Paid amount must be between zero and the total.
errors.invalid_date: Invoice date cannot be in the future.
errors.23505: This already exists (for example, the same supplier invoice number was entered before).
errors.duplicate_phone: Another customer already has this mobile number.
errors.phone_required: A mobile number is required for a loyalty card. Edit the customer first.
errors.loyalty_disabled: The loyalty programme is turned off (Loyalty → Plans).
errors.invalid_card_no: Card number is not valid (check digit).
errors.card_mismatch: This customer already has a different active card.
errors.renewal_pending: A renewal is already waiting to start for this card.
